integrity: Exact recomputable incidence enumeration in two standalone Python files; previously known graph invariants credited.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the thirteen-point projective plane of order three. The abstract graph F468 and F234B, their classical girth, diameter and symmetry, were known prior to this work. The claimed contribution is the Property-B point-recoloring realization and projective-frame bijection. The underlying classification uses Conder--Nedela; exact finite enumeration is independently replayable. Originality is best-knowledge rather than independently certified; original Wong and Biggs full texts were not available for exhaustive historical comparison. Independent audit not performed.
title: Bichromatic-line recoloring in the ternary projective plane realizes the Foster graph F468
